cjson.title: cJSON
cjson.description: A C library that parses, builds, prints and edits JSON as in-memory trees, with a utilities layer for JSON Pointer, JSON Patch and Merge Patch.

tsdown.title: tsdown
tsdown.description: A TypeScript/JavaScript bundler: it loads and normalizes user configs, runs per-format Rolldown builds, and finishes packages with generated exports, lint checks and optional single-executable output.

ruby_llm.title: ruby_llm
ruby_llm.description: A Ruby gem with one API for chat, streaming, embeddings, tool calling and model metadata across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock and other providers, plus Rails persistence helpers.

flask.title: Flask
flask.description: A Python WSGI micro-framework: an I/O-free sansio layer (Scaffold, Blueprint, App base) under the concrete Flask app, its request lifecycle and contexts, a test client and the command line.
flask.model_note: Claude Code host path: headless `claude -p --model sonnet` driving the codebase-explorer skill, whose subagents ran `claude-sonnet-5-5` (no gateway, no API config)
gaps: Host path: there is no `calls.csv`. Requests are subagent runs and prompt tokens are summed per turn of each subagent (cache reads counted every turn), so they do not compare with the API-path examples.

fmt.title: fmt
fmt.description: A C++ formatting library: a compiled core engine with extensions for compile-time format strings, chrono dates and times, colors, ranges, std types and OS I/O.
gaps: The second `find` row above, `FMT_EXPORT`, is a macro the parser took for a function name; the unit is the `dynamic_format_arg_store` class declared at `include/fmt/args.h:L66-L78`.

gson.title: Gson
gson.description: A Java library that converts objects to JSON and back, built on a streaming reader and writer, an in-memory JsonElement tree, reflective field binding and a pluggable TypeAdapter framework.
